clock: document_date — supersession folds on document dates (the default; set `change.clock = "narrative"` for order within a work)
tension selector: embedding top-k (k = 10, floor = 0.5) over decision — cross-document declared corpora select the embedding net; the classifier judges each pair
identity: team → canonical name (default; declare `identity = [...]` for an external key)
identity: component → path (external key, strict merge)
identity: service → path (external key, strict merge) — inherited from `component`
question shapes: enumerate [team, component, service]; relations [(none)]; events [incident]; aggregate [(none — a claim type with a `ref` attribute can be counted by it)]
